items.t: No SkyTrain station is in West Vancouver; nearest rapid transit: SeaBus at Lonsdale Quay, North Vancouver — TransLink states the SeaBus connects Downtown Vancouver to North Vancouver.
Nearest bus exchange/terminus: Park Royal, shown as the terminus on TransLink timetables for routes 251 and 255.
Route 251 Park Royal / Queens, TransLink: via Marine, Queens, 15th St, Mathers and 17th St to Park Royal.
Route 255 Capilano University / Dundarave, TransLink: via Marine, Lonsdale and Park Royal.
Routes 250, 253 and 254 also serve Park Royal, per the District of West Vancouver.
Ambleside Park: District of West Vancouver park.
West Vancouver Community Centre, 2121 Marine Drive: District of West Vancouver facility.
West Vancouver Memorial Library, 1950 Marine Drive, V7V 1J8: District municipal library.

faq.q: How do buses connect West Vancouver to downtown?
faq.a: Route 250 runs from Downtown Vancouver via Georgia Street, the Stanley Park Causeway and the Lions Gate Bridge along Marine Drive to Dundarave, with some trips continuing to Horseshoe Bay.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in West Vancouver?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in West Vancouver?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in West Vancouver?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.
